<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<h:html xmlns:h="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:orx="http://openrosa.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2002/xforms" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:jr="http://openrosa.org/javarosa" xmlns:vellum="http://commcarehq.org/xforms/vellum">
	<h:head>
		<h:title>Miner Follow-up</h:title>
		<model>
			<instance>
				<data xmlns:jrm="http://dev.commcarehq.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://openrosa.org/formdesigner/655269e2" uiVersion="1" version="1" name="Miner Follow-up">
					<var>
						<miner>
							<fullname />
							<nrc />
							<date_of_birth />
							<primary_mineral />
							<miner_status />
						</miner>
					</var>
					<resume />
					<site_visit_date />
					<production_update />
					<eligibility_change />
					<followup_notes />
				</data>
			</instance>
			<instance src="jr://instance/casedb" id="casedb" />
			<instance src="jr://instance/session" id="commcaresession" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var" nodeset="/data/var" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/miner" nodeset="/data/var/miner" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/miner/fullname" nodeset="/data/var/miner/fullname" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/miner/nrc" nodeset="/data/var/miner/nrc" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/miner/date_of_birth" nodeset="/data/var/miner/date_of_birth" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/miner/primary_mineral" nodeset="/data/var/miner/primary_mineral" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/var/miner/miner_status" nodeset="/data/var/miner/miner_status" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/resume" nodeset="/data/resume" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/site_visit_date" nodeset="/data/site_visit_date" type="xsd:date" required="true()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/production_update" nodeset="/data/production_update" type="xsd:string" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/eligibility_change" nodeset="/data/eligibility_change" required="true()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/followup_notes" nodeset="/data/followup_notes" type="xsd:string" />
			<setvalue event="xforms-ready" vellum:ref="#form/var/miner/fullname" ref="/data/var/miner/fullname" vellum:value="#case/full_name" value="instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_id = instance('commcaresession')/session/data/case_id]/full_name" />
			<setvalue event="xforms-ready" vellum:ref="#form/var/miner/nrc" ref="/data/var/miner/nrc" vellum:value="#case/nrc_number" value="instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_id = instance('commcaresession')/session/data/case_id]/nrc_number" />
			<setvalue event="xforms-ready" vellum:ref="#form/var/miner/date_of_birth" ref="/data/var/miner/date_of_birth" vellum:value="#case/date_of_birth" value="instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_id = instance('commcaresession')/session/data/case_id]/date_of_birth" />
			<setvalue event="xforms-ready" vellum:ref="#form/var/miner/primary_mineral" ref="/data/var/miner/primary_mineral" vellum:value="#case/primary_mineral" value="instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_id = instance('commcaresession')/session/data/case_id]/primary_mineral" />
			<setvalue event="xforms-ready" vellum:ref="#form/var/miner/miner_status" ref="/data/var/miner/miner_status" vellum:value="#case/miner_status" value="instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_id = instance('commcaresession')/session/data/case_id]/miner_status" />
			<itext>
				<translation lang="en" default="">
					<text id="resume-label">
						<value>#### **Miner details**
| Attribute | Info |
| - |- |
| Full Name | <output value="/data/var/miner/fullname" vellum:value="#form/var/miner/fullname" /> |
| NRC (National Registration Card) | <output value="/data/var/miner/date_of_birth" vellum:value="#form/var/miner/date_of_birth" /> |
| Date of birth | <output value="/data/var/miner/date_of_birth" vellum:value="#form/var/miner/date_of_birth" /> |
| Primary mineral  | <output value="/data/var/miner/primary_mineral" vellum:value="#form/var/miner/primary_mineral" /> |
| Status | <output value="/data/var/miner/miner_status" vellum:value="#form/var/miner/miner_status" /> |</value>
						<value form="markdown">#### **Miner details**
| Attribute | Info |
| - |- |
| Full Name | <output value="/data/var/miner/fullname" vellum:value="#form/var/miner/fullname" /> |
| NRC (National Registration Card) | <output value="/data/var/miner/date_of_birth" vellum:value="#form/var/miner/date_of_birth" /> |
| Date of birth | <output value="/data/var/miner/date_of_birth" vellum:value="#form/var/miner/date_of_birth" /> |
| Primary mineral  | <output value="/data/var/miner/primary_mineral" vellum:value="#form/var/miner/primary_mineral" /> |
| Status | <output value="/data/var/miner/miner_status" vellum:value="#form/var/miner/miner_status" /> |</value>
					</text>
					<text id="site_visit_date-label">
						<value>Site Visit Date</value>
					</text>
					<text id="production_update-label">
						<value>Production Update / Notes</value>
					</text>
					<text id="production_update-hint">
						<value>Describe any production changes or observations</value>
					</text>
					<text id="eligibility_change-label">
						<value>Updated Miner Status</value>
					</text>
					<text id="eligibility_change-credit_eligible-label">
						<value>Credit-eligible</value>
					</text>
					<text id="eligibility_change-insurance_enrolled-label">
						<value>Insurance Enrolled</value>
					</text>
					<text id="eligibility_change-active-label">
						<value>Active</value>
					</text>
					<text id="followup_notes-label">
						<value>Additional Notes</value>
					</text>
				</translation>
			</itext>
		</model>
		<vellum:hashtags>{"#case/full_name":null,"#case/nrc_number":null,"#case/date_of_birth":null,"#case/primary_mineral":null,"#case/miner_status":null}</vellum:hashtags>
		<vellum:hashtagTransforms>{"prefixes":{"#case/":"instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_id = instance('commcaresession')/session/data/case_id]/","#user/":"instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_type = 'commcare-user'][hq_user_id = instance('commcaresession')/session/context/userid]/"}}</vellum:hashtagTransforms>
	</h:head>
	<h:body>
		<group vellum:ref="#form/var" ref="/data/var">
			<group vellum:ref="#form/var/miner" ref="/data/var/miner" />
		</group>
		<trigger vellum:ref="#form/resume" ref="/data/resume" appearance="minimal">
			<label ref="jr:itext('resume-label')" />
		</trigger>
		<input vellum:ref="#form/site_visit_date" ref="/data/site_visit_date">
			<label ref="jr:itext('site_visit_date-label')" />
		</input>
		<input vellum:ref="#form/production_update" ref="/data/production_update">
			<label ref="jr:itext('production_update-label')" />
			<hint ref="jr:itext('production_update-hint')" />
		</input>
		<select1 vellum:ref="#form/eligibility_change" ref="/data/eligibility_change">
			<label ref="jr:itext('eligibility_change-label')" />
			<item>
				<label ref="jr:itext('eligibility_change-credit_eligible-label')" />
				<value>credit_eligible</value>
			</item>
			<item>
				<label ref="jr:itext('eligibility_change-insurance_enrolled-label')" />
				<value>insurance_enrolled</value>
			</item>
			<item>
				<label ref="jr:itext('eligibility_change-active-label')" />
				<value>active</value>
			</item>
		</select1>
		<input vellum:ref="#form/followup_notes" ref="/data/followup_notes">
			<label ref="jr:itext('followup_notes-label')" />
		</input>
	</h:body>
</h:html>
